title: Investigation of coal pore structure evolution under temperature–time coupling using low-field nuclear magnetic resonance
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,44125-44133
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06910F, Paper
Open Access

Ziwen Dong, Haojie Zhang, Xian Wu, Ronghao Xu, Song Kong
This study employed LF-NMR combined with oil bath heat treatment experiments to systematically characterize variations in T2 relaxation spectra, pore size distribution, throat structure, and porosity in coal samples.
